french_source_text: Si l'on remarque que M/V est canoniquement isomorphe à M-hat/V-bar
english_prior_text: If we have that M/V is canonically isomorphic to M-hat/V-bar
required_english_text: If we note that M/V is canonically isomorphic to M-hat/V-bar
rationale: French si l'on remarque que means if we note/observe that. The inherited if we have that is nonidiomatic and obscures the inferential cue. The repair changes no mathematical content.

french_source_text: un bifoncteur en M et N dans la catégorie des A-modules linéairement topologisés
english_prior_text: a bifunctor in M and N on the category of linearly topologized A-modules
required_english_text: a bifunctor in M and N in the category of linearly topologized A-modules
rationale: The French says dans la catégorie and standard mathematical English likewise says a functor in/on objects in a category, here a bifunctor in M and N in the category. Replacing on with in removes a grammatical defect without changing scope.

french_source_text: J idéal ouvert de A tel que J.B subset K, J.C subset L; il en existe toujours
english_prior_text: J the open ideal of A such that ...; it always exists
required_english_text: J an open ideal of A such that ...; such an ideal always exists
rationale: The French indefinite construction and il en existe toujours assert existence, not uniqueness. The inherited definite article the falsely suggested a distinguished unique ideal. The repair restores the exact existential force.

french_source_text: il existe un A-homomorphisme continu et un seul w ... et un seul tel que u=w o rho et v=w o sigma
english_prior_text: there exists a unique continuous A-homomorphism w ... such that ... (without source note)
required_english_text: state uniqueness once and add an immediate visible stable-ID note that the French repeats et un seul
rationale: The direct authority visibly repeats the same uniqueness phrase within one clause. The surrounding universal property and following proof establish one unique map w. Diplomatic French must preserve both printed occurrences; idiomatic English states the intended uniqueness once and discloses the source duplication immediately.

french_source_text: on en conclut que sur B tensor_A M, le produit tensoriel des topologies ...
english_prior_text: we conclude that over B tensor_A M ...
required_english_text: we conclude that on B tensor_A M ...
rationale: French sur names the module carrying the topology. Standard English is the topology on a module, not over a module. The repair preserves the carrier exactly.

french_source_text: le produit tensoriel des topologies de B et de M est la topologie K-préadique
english_prior_text: the tensor products of the topologies of B and M is the K-preadic topology
required_english_text: the tensor product of the topologies of B and M is the K-preadic topology
rationale: The French subject is singular le produit tensoriel, and the construction defines one tensor-product topology. The inherited plural disagreed with both the source and its singular verb. Restoring the singular is mathematically and grammatically exact.
